messages.subject: help with graphing
parts:
Suppose that I have a data frame as below

x1 x2 x3 ... x10 wk1 wk2 ... wk208

For each record, x1, x2, x3 ... x10 are attributes. and wk1, wk2, ...,
wk208 are the sales recoreded for this attribute combination. Suppose
that now, that I want to do the following

1. Next, I want to draw a time plot with X axis being the weeks and
the Y axis is the sales values (for wk1, wk2, till wk25) for each
combination of x5 and x6 (for example). Suppose that the number of
combinations of x5 and x6 are large (say 100) and I want to have on
each page 6 graphs, how can I do this.

Sorry, guys - answers may be there in Hadley's book/pdf file. But like
everyone else, I am running with time and don't know why :)


any ggplot2 code to do this will be appreciated. Thanks in advance.
Satish
